title: OCPI 2.1.1 AuthorizationInfo with the end-user pricing extension
description: Response data of POST /tokens/{token_uid}/authorize. Only the extension field and the members it depends on are constrained; the rest of AuthorizationInfo is validated by the OCPI schema, not this one.

end_user_tariff.description: EXTENSION. The tariff the eMSP applies to this driver at this location, VAT-inclusive. Omit when no price can be resolved. Ignored by the CPO when allowed is not ALLOWED.
